title: Email to registered companies about the WebFiling security issue
text:
Companies House is contacting every company’s registered email address between Tuesday 17 March and Thursday 19 March, about a security issue identified with the WebFiling service on Friday 13 March 2026.

 This is a copy of the email which explains what happened, how to check your details and what steps to take if you have any concerns.

 Emails will come from companies.house@notifications.service.gov.uk .

 For more information, read the  statement from the Chief Executive of Companies House on the WebFiling security issue .
